questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The fishing cats are on the list of endangered species. People hunt too many of them.
options: A. The fishing cats are on the list of endangered species; otherwise, people hunt too many of them.
B. The fishing cats are on the list of endangered species since people hunt too many of them.
C. The fishing cats are on the list of endangered species; by contrast, people hunt too many of them.
D. The fishing cats are on the list of endangered species; therefore, people hunt too many of them.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “Since” diễn đạt đúng quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Mèo cá nằm trong danh sách các loài có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng vì người ta săn bắt quá nhiều.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The sick pangolin has received medical support. He is expected to live longer.
options: A. The sick pangolin's life expectancy is expected to be longer as he has received medical support.
B. The pangolin is expected to be still sick although he has received longer medical support.
C. The pangolin is expected to receive medical support as he has been sick for a long time.
D. The sick pangolin is expected not to live longer even though he has received longer medical support.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Đáp án A kết hợp đúng hai mệnh đề nguyên nhân – kết quả: nhận hỗ trợ y tế → sống lâu hơn. Dịch nghĩa: Con tê tê bị bệnh được kỳ vọng sẽ sống lâu hơn vì nó đã nhận được hỗ trợ y tế.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Oil drilling is one of the factors that cause damage to marine life.
options: A. Oil drilling not only harms marine life but also other factors.
B. Marine life is not damaged despite the oil drilling.
C. Oil drilling is the only factor that causes damage to marine life.
D. Marine life is damaged by several factors, including oil drilling.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: “one of the factors” = một trong các nguyên nhân. Dịch nghĩa: Sinh vật biển bị tổn hại bởi nhiều yếu tố, bao gồm cả việc khoan dầu.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. They want to go sightseeing in the local national park.
options: A. They want to do some sightseeing in the local national park.
B. The local national park is not allowed to go sightseeing.
C. They prefer to visit the local national park for sightseeing.
D. They enjoy going sightseeing in the local national park.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “want to go sightseeing” = “want to do some sightseeing”. Dịch nghĩa: Họ muốn đi tham quan một chút trong công viên quốc gia địa phương.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The biggest tree in the national park is a thousand years old.
options: A. The thousand-year-old tree is not as big as the one in the national park.
B. The national park is the biggest one and is a thousand years old.
C. The biggest tree in the national park is a thousand-year-old one.
D. The national park has a big thousand-year-old tree.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Câu C diễn đạt lại đúng đủ thông tin nhất. Dịch nghĩa: Cây lớn nhất trong công viên quốc gia là một cây có tuổi đời một nghìn năm.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We risk falling into robot uprisings, for the convincing reason that we are like to suffer from more diseases when not we but the robots do everything.
options: A. Diseases will be a convincing reason for us to make more use of robots in everyday activities.
B. The heavy use of robots will convince us that we will suffer from more diseases.
C. The robots will have to do so many things that they will be ill and provoke uprisings.
D. Depending on robots will weaken us and stand a chance of us facing robot rebellion.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Câu gốc diễn tả: nếu để robot làm mọi việc → con người yếu đi → dễ dẫn đến nổi loạn từ robot. Câu D là câu diễn đạt lại đúng nhất. Dịch nghĩa: Việc phụ thuộc vào robot sẽ khiến chúng ta yếu đi và có nguy cơ phải đối mặt với sự nổi dậy của robot.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Such is its renown and prestige that this nature reserve attracts millions of international tourists every year.
options: A. This nature reserve is so renowned and prestigious that it attracts millions of international tourists every year.
B. The nature reserve attracts millions of international tourists in spite of the renown and prestige.
C. Millions of international tourists are so attractive that this nature reserve is renowned and prestigious.
D. It is such an attractive nature reserve that millions of international tourists are renowned and prestigious.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Cấu trúc “Such + noun + that …” tương đương với “so + adjective + that …”. Dịch nghĩa: Khu bảo tồn thiên nhiên này nổi tiếng và có uy tín đến mức thu hút hàng triệu du khách quốc tế mỗi năm.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Today there are more than 600 elephants in Addo Elephant National Park and you'd be very unlucky not to see some.
options: A. Among 600 elephants in Addo Elephant National Park, there are some very unlucky ones.
B. You'd be very unlucky to see some of the 600 elephants in Addo Elephant National Park.
C. Elephants in Addo Elephant National Park are so many and frequently-seen that if you can't see some of them, you are very unlucky.
D. You are very unlucky because there are more than 600 elephants in Addo Elephant National Park but you can't see any.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Câu gốc có cấu trúc "There are so many ... that you'd be unlucky not to see some." → tương đương với C. Dịch nghĩa: Ở Công viên Voi Addo có rất nhiều voi, đến mức nếu bạn không nhìn thấy con nào thì đúng là xui xẻo thật.
